h1: Custom Reflective Lanyards for Safety and Visibility
metaDescription: Order custom reflective lanyards for high-visibility branding. Perfect for safety managers and event teams. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Reflective lanyards keep your crew visible in low-light conditions, from warehouse floors to evening events. Unlike standard lanyards, the reflective stripe on styles like the 3/4" Reflective Lanyard with Plastic Clamshell & O-Ring catches light for added safety. Print your logo on the front for branding that works around the clock. Ideal for safety managers, event staff, and construction site teams who need visibility and professional identity in one accessory.
heroAltText: Custom reflective lanyards with printed logos and reflective stripes for high-visibility branding and safety.
